draft.title: Exponential growth and decay
card: In an exponential pattern, the amount is multiplied by the same number each step. That number is called the multiplier.
the multiplier is greater than 1, so the amount gets bigger each step. A population that rises by 10% each year has a multiplier of 1.1.
the multiplier is between 0 and 1, so the amount gets smaller each step. A drink whose excess heat falls by 20% each minute has a multiplier of 0.8.
Example: 200 bacteria double every hour. After 1 hour there are \(200 \times 2 = 400\). After 2 hours there are \(400 \times 2 = 800\). The multiplier is 2, so this is growth.
draft.remember: Multiplier above 1 gives growth. Multiplier between 0 and 1 gives decay.

a.q: A town's population is multiplied by 1.05 each year. Which describes this?
opts: Exponential growth, as the multiplier is above 1
Exponential decay, as the multiplier is above 1
Exponential growth, as the multiplier is below 1
Exponential decay, as the multiplier is below 1
a.why: The multiplier 1.05 is greater than 1, so the population gets bigger each year. That is growth. Decay needs a multiplier between 0 and 1.
a.clue: Is the multiplier bigger or smaller than 1?

b.q: A car is worth $20,000. Its value is multiplied by 0.9 each year. What is it worth after 2 years?
b.why: Each year the value is multiplied by 0.9. After 1 year it is \(20{,}000 \times 0.9 = 18{,}000\), and after 2 years it is \(18{,}000 \times 0.9 = 16{,}200\). Taking off 10% of the starting value twice gives $16,000, but the second 10% is taken from the new, smaller value.
b.clue: Multiply by 0.9 twice, using the new value each time.

a.best: Exponential growth, as the multiplier is above 1

check.summary: No problems found. The card's multipliers (1.1 for a 10% rise, 0.8 for a 20% fall) are correct, and both questions and explanations agree with it (20,000 × 0.9 × 0.9 = 16,200).
